delete.description: Not Implemented: Delete a custom image of any project.

Admin-delete a server.

Default: standard deletion — a server in the pending state is not deletable.

When ``ALLOW_DELETE_PENDING_SERVER`` is enabled: permits deleting a pending
server. The delete is retried against core up to ``FORCE_DELETE_CORE_RETRIES``
times, then the server is removed from the CMP database regardless of the
result. Related resources that were never created on core are cleaned up too.

post.description:
Associate floating IP to a server.

Claims the Floating IP in the DB and schedules a FloatingIPBindingSyncEvent
that moves the router gateway onto the FIP's external network and binds the
FIP to the private IP's port on core.

Disassociate floating IP from a server.

Releases the Floating IP in the DB and schedules a
FloatingIPBindingSyncEvent; the handler unbinds the FIP on core, then keeps
or drops the router gateway based on the remaining active FIPs and the
``internet_access`` flag.
